notes.title: Today's Tweaks & Changes & YOU
notes.notes:
Hello! We've posted an update to Voodoo Vince: Remastered. This has some changes we hope will help us track down the issues some players have reported with the following:

- Stuttering and strange sync issues with cinematic sequences. Here's the deal: We've substituted regular stereo mixes for our usual 5.1 surround during the opening scene and the long scene where Vince first meets Kosmo's big green head. If you've had this issue, please start a New Game by moving over to Vince in the Voodoo Shop. Play the intro and the first level and let us know if you still experiencing problems. The rest of the scenes still have 5.1 mixes, so if you feel like playing further we can see how those compare. This will tell us if the way we're converting cinematic audio down to stereo is the culprit.

- Game boot-up problems. These are two-fold. First, we've updated our steam_api.dll for those experiencing the endless cloud save sync where the game doesn't actually start. We believe this will help with that. Second, for the lucky players who might be experiencing DirectX 11 compatibility issues, the game now generates an error message vs. just crashing or showing a black screen. If you get this, please post a comment here with the code you see, or email support@beepgames.com

These don't fix the issues, but what we learn will help make that possible.

Thanks for your patience!

Beep

notes.title: Update 2 is away!
notes.notes:
Hi,

Lots of little and a few big issues addressed in the latest update to Voodoo Vince: Remastered:

- Fix for game speed slowdown in certain levels that caused Vince to move in slow-mo at times.
- Removed resolution settings in Options in favor of just windowed and fullscreen based on user’s screen resolution. 
- Carnival ride sound effect changed from shrieking cats to something less murder-inducing.
- Fix for saved game timestamps in Voodoo Shop being all the same after a cloud save restore.
- Rare but awful bug where players losing last life after raising the rotating platforms in Inside The Kosmobot could not progress when returning to the level.
- Improvement to Ghost Trolley map navigation input. It’s easier to move between nodes when choosing a trolley stop now.
- Level stats now limited correctly for levels played more than once.
- Fix for controller being active in more than one game window at once.

notes.title: Update and fixes are live!
notes.notes:
We've updated Voodoo Vince: Remastered to address some issues we've heard about since our launch yesterday:

1. Some players reported seeing a black screen at launch and/or a freeze at the Beep Games logo screen. This has been fixed.

2. Fixed issues with toggling full screen mode on/off with certain high end monitors.

3.  Fixed bug that caused animation and physics to run at hyper speed when monitor refresh rate was set to higher than 60hz.

4. Fixed Pin Swing keyboard bug that prevented using the move while Vince is in mid-air.

5. Fixed rare crash in Busy Butler level. As it was caused by audio cross fade this may fix issues in other parts of the game.
